Name: CAMERA_RUMBLE_PARAM_ST
Description: Gamepad vibration (rumble) settings, usually played from TAE events: the rumble to use, its distance attenuation, lifespan, change over time and air/ground multipliers.

Fields.Name: Rumble ID
Fields.Description: ID of the rumble type to use.

Fields.Name: HD Pad Rumble ID
Fields.Description: ID of the rumble type to use for HD Pads.

Fields.Name: Attenuation Start Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which the rumble starts to fade, in metres. When set from a TAE, -1 disables distance attenuation.

Fields.Name: Attenuation End Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which the rumble has fully faded, in metres.

Fields.Name: FoV Type
Fields.Description: Field of View application method.

Fields.Name: Priority
Fields.Description: Higher values correlate to higher priority.

Fields.Name: Vibration Target (PC)
Fields.Description: Only valid when called from the player character's TAE. Setting it to 'PC Only' disables the distance attenuation parameters.

Fields.Name: Update Distance Attenuation in Real Time
Fields.Description: If ON, distance attenuation is recalculated in real time while the rumble plays.

Fields.Name: Update Air/Ground Rate in Real Time
Fields.Description: If ON, the air and ground multipliers are reapplied in real time while the rumble plays.

Fields.Name: HD Rumble Playback Slot Index
Fields.Description: HD rumble playback slot index, 0 to 3.

Fields.Name: Lifespan
Fields.Description: Rumble lifespan, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Attenuation Pause Rate [%]
Fields.Description: Rumble multiplier while distance attenuation is paused (between the pause start and end distances). In percent.

Fields.Name: Attenuation Pause Start Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which distance attenuation is paused, in metres.

Fields.Name: Attenuation Pause End Distance
Fields.Description: Distance at which the distance attenuation pause ends, in metres.

Fields.Name: Time Change Rate [%]
Fields.Description: Rumble multiplier reached at the end of the Change Time, in percent.

Fields.Name: Change Time
Fields.Description: Time over which the rumble changes to the Time Change Rate, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Air Rate (Self)
Fields.Description: Rumble multiplier while your own character is in the air, in percent.

Fields.Name: Ground Rate (Self)
Fields.Description: Rumble multiplier while your own character is on the ground, in percent.

Fields.Name: Air Rate (Other)
Fields.Description: Rumble multiplier while the other character is in the air, in percent.

Fields.Name: Ground Rate (Other)
Fields.Description: Rumble multiplier while the other character is on the ground, in percent.
